name: conv-v5
notes: 2026-11-15: conv-v4 with the parameters added since switched on. Code supply: the oracle's unknown-entity distrust for code sources and executables 0.5 -> 0.7, and installing a package nothing vouches for and that neither the owner nor a grant named (npm, PyPI and URL installs; an owner-named package stays exempt under sudo too) carries sensitivity 0.67, so an unknown origin for code weighs more than an unknown party for data. A look-alike of a vouched-for entry that supplies code or tools takes a minimum risk of 0.6, so a one-letter swap of a known registry or tool cannot hide under the review line. Relief: a destination a scheduled task names itself is relieved like one the owner named in a message, since the owner wrote that task; not on heartbeat or sub-agent turns, whose text the agent can write (a sub-agent's task comes from the parent agent, a heartbeat file can be agent-written); a destination or recipient the owner's own configuration supplies is relieved of unknown-party distrust. Origins: a data path the agent picks on an owner-message turn makes no origin claim (0.0): choosing where to put the owner's work is the agent's job. Escalation: a rise in consequence needs three rising steps, not two, so an ordinary read-then-write sequence is not a trend. Lineage and context weights: the mail-filter arm 0.6 -> 0.8 on overreach, sensitivity, reach and irreversibility; a privileged role granted on a remote service the request does not name 0.6 overreach; a pushed commit whose summary lists a credential file 0.8 overreach; a package one edit or confusable from a word of the request 0.9 concealment; a payee or recipient one letter from a person the owner named 0.9 overreach; a sub-agent spawned out of the owner's sight 0.75 reach and 0.6 irreversibility; an unknown MCP server or plugin that is a send's only destination 0.5 distrust. Taint floor 0.3 -> 0.15: the origin fixes removed the false origins the floor used to amplify, so the lower floor no longer lifts ordinary calls. It assumes the exposure judge read this request's new untrusted content: when that judge did not answer (an error, a timeout, not run), the floor stays 0.3 (taint_floor_unjudged). Everything else as conv-v4, which stays selectable.
